title: What’s New in Netskope’s FedRAMP High Environment
summary: What's New in Netskope’s FedRAMP High Environment Securing AI applications, protecting sensitive data beyond the browser, and troubleshooting performance
body_markdown:
## What’s New in Netskope’s FedRAMP High Environment


Securing AI applications, protecting sensitive data beyond the browser, and troubleshooting performance before it disrupts the mission. These capabilities are among the latest additions to


[Netskope NewEdge Government](https://www.netskope.com/resources/solution-briefs/netskope-govcloud-fedramp-high-authorized-platform) , the FedRAMP High authorized offering of the Netskope One platform, which brings together SASE, data security and AI security to help US Government agencies understand risk in context, enforce policies in real time, and protect sensitive data without compromising performance.


Here’s what’s new, why it matters, and what agencies should know before deployment.


## Enterprise Browser brings governed browsing to FedRAMP High


Copying, pasting, uploading, and entering information into AI tools most commonly happens in the browser, making it one of the most practical places to enforce data policy.


[Netskope One Enterprise Browser](https://www.netskope.com/products/enterprise-browser) is now generally available in FedRAMP High environments, giving federal agencies greater control over browser activity and the sensitive data users interact with.


Agencies can apply granular data loss prevention (DLP) and activity controls, manage browser extensions, and enforce consistent security policies across browsing sessions. This is particularly important as employees increasingly access AI tools and cloud applications through the browser, creating new opportunities for sensitive data exposure.


*Availability: Supported on Windows and macOS, with Enterprise Browser 1.6.2 or later. Support is currently limited to internet destinations and does not include private apps through Netskope One Private Access. For more information review the*[release notes](https://docs.netskope.com/en/netskope-release-notes-version-143-0-0#enterprise-browser-general-availability-in-fedramp-high) *.*


## AI Gateway secures interactions between applications and AI


Agencies are increasingly integrating AI into their own applications and workflows, not just using public chatbots. But these integrations introduce a different set of security challenges, particularly when sensitive data moves between agency applications and large language models (LLMs).


[Netskope Skylight AI Gateway](https://www.netskope.com/products/ai-gateway) helps agencies govern interactions between internal applications, APIs and privately hosted or public AI services. With real-time visibility, inline policy enforcement, and data protection agencies can better understand and control what information is being shared with AI models.


Consider an agency that adds an AI assistant to an internal case-management system. Prompts may contain sensitive information or reference records that shouldn’t be shared with certain AI services. With AI Gateway in the traffic path, security teams can inspect those interactions and enforce policies before sensitive information reaches the model.


For more information read the


[Netskope Skylight AI Gateway datasheet](https://www.netskope.com/resources/data-sheets/netskope-skylight-ai-gateway-data-sheet) .


## DLP on Demand extends data protection into agency-managed environments


Not all sensitive data passes through a user’s browser or a managed endpoint. Federal agencies also operate applications and workflows across on-premise infrastructure and customer-owned cloud environments, where consistent data protection can be more difficult to enforce.


The


[Netskope One DLP on Demand](https://www.netskope.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/2026-04-Netskope-One-DLP-On-Demand-DS-978-1.pdf) customer hosted virtual appliance now supports FedRAMP High environments, extending Netskope’s DLP inspection capabilities into customer-managed infrastructure. Agencies can integrate DLP inspection into supported applications and workflows to identify sensitive information and apply consistent data protection policies without routing that inspection through a traditional browser or endpoint security control. This gives agencies another way to extend data protection across their environments while using the same DLP capabilities available in Netskope’s cloud service.


*For more information review the*[release notes](https://docs.netskope.com/en/netskope-release-notes-version-143-0-0#dlp-on-demand--dlp-inspection-in-customer-network--on-prem-local-public-cloud-owned-by-customer----compliance) *.*


## Expanded Digital Experience Management (DEM) now available in FedRAMP High


When an agency application slows down, identifying the cause isn’t always straightforward. The issue could originate within the user’s device, the network, or the application itself. Zero trust depends on knowing whether access is working, not only whether it’s allowed.


[Netskope One DEM](https://www.netskope.com/products/digital-experience-management) helps IT teams pinpoint performance issues and resolve them faster.


DEM Professional, Enterprise Starter, and Enterprise are all now available in FedRAMP High, expanding visibility into user experience, network connectivity, and application performance. Depending on edition, capabilities include real-user monitoring, synthetic testing, browser-based performance monitoring, and site-level diagnostics. Professional monitors each employee’s experience by combining real-user and synthetic monitoring.


With greater visibility into the factors affecting application performance, agencies can troubleshoot issues more efficiently, reduce time spent identifying root causes, and improve the experience for employees accessing mission-critical applications.


Review


[Netskope One DEM](https://www.netskope.com/products/digital-experience-management) for more information.


## More capabilities. One FedRAMP High platform


These updates expand the security and performance capabilities available through


[Netskope NewEdge Government](https://www.netskope.com/get-started#demo) , helping agencies protect data, secure AI, and advance their missions.


To see these capabilities in action,


[request a demo](https://www.netskope.com/get-started#demo) and the Netskope Federal team will reach out.
